div.div:
The trace is the seam. An algorithm cannot see a device, and a device cannot
see an algorithm — so a change to one cannot quietly alter the other.

div.div:
A trace of 10⁹ operations is 24 GB, so above roughly 10⁷ records the analytic path
prices instead. It is not a separate theory: the two are differenced wherever both
can run, and the arms must agree on the advantage within a stated factor.
